projectState.summary: Byte 16b-a is approved and merged on main with Claude's durable review artifact included. The Form Score panel exposes deterministic app-owned form variants: Classic Arc, Early Hook, and Wide Return. The selected variant drives transport arrangement, harmonic context, playback section decisions, and form scoring through the existing lookahead path. Claude confirmed this is a real human-selected audio path, Classic Arc remains default, and Early Hook reaches chorus at beat 16. Forward steer: improve form-score variant discrimination before auto-drive; keep the winner displayed but not auto-applied.
